question: Can familiar running resume without adding the missed run as debt?
Can an available trainer preserve intent without inventing equipment?
Does the hold prevent unreviewed return-to-training advice?
Are dose and exercise-specific loads appropriate after fatigue?
Does an unplanned hard ride affect the next run without earning running exposure?
Is pain separated from soreness and is professional escalation appropriate?
Are partial sets represented honestly without inferring stroke/interval completion?
Are movement coverage, exact exercise and completed dose kept separate?
Is missing sync preserved as unknown rather than a miss?
Are session IDs, combined transitions and protected commitments preserved?
